title: Critical Language Scholarship - Azerbaijani Program (Baku, Azerbaijan)
description: A fully funded U.S. Department of State summer program that sends U.S. undergraduate and graduate students to Baku, Azerbaijan for roughly 7-10 weeks of intensive Azerbaijani-language and cultural immersion instruction, hosted by the Azerbaijan University of Languages (AUL) and implemented by American Councils for International Education. Instruction is offered at beginning, advanced beginning, intermediate, and advanced levels, with students living with host families and taking part in structured cultural enrichment activities alongside coursework equivalent to roughly a full academic year of language study. The program covers international airfare, tuition, housing, and meals; selection is competitive nationwide across all CLS languages and sites.
org: Critical Language Scholarship Program (U.S. Department of State / American Councils for International Education)
visaNote: Participants receive program-arranged entry/visa status for Azerbaijan through American Councils; no independent work authorization is involved.
